# Dependency records

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

The verification platform requires Apple Silicon, macOS 26.5.2, Xcode SDK 26.5, and Python 3.12. The Python environment is installed by feature. Each `.in` file lists direct dependencies, and the corresponding `.lock` files list resolved versions. PyPI archives other than MOSS include hashes. Git dependencies are fixed to a specified commit.

`scripts/fetch_model.py` Verifies the SHA-256 weight by directly downloading it. `bin/install omni` Verifies the disk image, application signatures, certification status, and retrieval weights. `bin/install depth-anything` Verifies the files within the Core ML package and then compiles them using the system framework. The MOSS upstream package relies on PyTorch during import, while this project uses MLX for the transcription path. The installers for Hy-MT2 and Privacy Filter build source code packages from fixed Git commits, and their execution dependencies are installed with corresponding hash-lock files.

Apple Vision, PDFKit, Speech, Translation, Natural Language, and Foundation Models are provided with the system. This project uses the public Swift API in macOS 26. Language resources and native system models are managed by macOS.

Optional `apple-fm-python` uses the Apple Python SDK 0.2.2 source package and the fixed `ctypesgen` 1.1.1. The installer compiles the official Swift-C bindings using existing macOS SDKs, reusing the system’s models and language assets. [Apple Python SDK Release Package](https://pypi.org/project/apple-fm-sdk/0.2.2/)

Reference implementation. [PaddleOCR Apple Silicon Tutorial](https://www.paddleocr.ai/main/en/version3.x/pipeline_usage/PaddleOCR-VL-Apple-Silicon.html) · [Apple Vision Document Recognition](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/vision/recognizedocumentsrequest) · [Apple Speech](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/speech/) · [Apple Foundation Models](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundationmodels) · [Codex Configuration Reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference) · [Claude Code MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)
